```lean
theorem lg_target {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [LE β] [Zero β] {v₁ : α₁ → β} {v₂ : α₂ → β} : 0 ≤ Sum.elim v₁ v₂ ↔ 0 ≤ v₁ ∧ 0 ≤ v₂ := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [Sum.elim_zero]
    exact h
  · intro h12
    refine le_trans (Sum.elim_le v₁ v₂) _
    exact le_trans (le_add_zero (v₁ _)) (le_add_zero (v₂ _))
```
